scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:fast && pnpm run test:focused && pnpm run verify:contracts && pnpm run verify:full
scripts.lint:fast: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path)) for root in (pathlib.Path("src"), pathlib.Path("tests")) for path in root.rglob("*.py")]' && cargo fmt --all -- --check
